sources.title_zh: 更新您的 IDE 以恢復 Copilot 使用量指標中的代理程式活動
sources.title_en: Update your IDE to restore agent activity in Copilot usage metrics
sources.title_original: Update your IDE to restore agent activity in Copilot usage metrics
sources.summary: If your Copilot usage metrics have shown agent activity or agent lines of code falling while Copilot usage kept growing, we’ve found the cause, and a fix is rolling out… The post Update your IDE to restore agent activity in Copilot usage metrics appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
sources.summary_zh: 如果您的 Copilot 使用量指標顯示代理程式活動或代理程式程式碼行數在 Copilot 使用量持續成長的同時卻在下降，我們已經找到了原因，並且正在推出修復程式……本文譯自 The GitHub Blog 的 The post Update your IDE to restore agent activity in Copilot usage metrics
